name: Roam Research
description:
Roam Research is an outliner-based, networked note-taking tool. This connector lets Claude work directly with your selected Roam graphs.

Claude can:
- Read and search your pages, blocks, daily notes, comments, and backlinks
- Run structured and Datalog queries across your graph
- Create and edit pages, blocks, and daily-note entries, add comments, and reorganize blocks
- Append or capture information to your encrypted graphs

At the start of work in a graph, Claude loads that graph's guidelines, including your naming conventions, page structure, and recorded preferences, so its reads and writes match how you actually use Roam instead of imposing a generic format.

You stay in control:
- Choose which graphs to connect and what access level each graph gets
- Every change Claude makes is attributed to a distinct "(AI)" author in your graph, so AI edits are always easy to find and review
- Adjust a graph's access or disconnect it at any time

To get started, add the connector, sign in to Roam, and pick which graph(s) Claude should use.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Roam Research to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Roam Research to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.roamresearch.com/mcp/claude. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Roam Research MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Roam Research lists 20 MCP tools, including add_comment, append_to_daily_note, create_block, create_page, datalog_query, delete_block, delete_page, get_backlinks, get_block, get_comments, get_graph_guidelines, and get_page.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Roam Research?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Roam Research in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Roam Research MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Roam Research requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Roam Research is developed by Roam Research Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
